content: Jesucristoʼgi-bensulidi, we-napneg-igargi obined

Bela-dulemar-bensurmaladi, na sogmaladi, we-Jesús, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duleye, a-dulemala Bab-Dummadgi burbar gwalulesmalad. Ar dulemar bela Bab-Dummad-sabmaladi, Bab-Dummad-mimmigan sabgumarbaloed.
Ar deyob, anmar Bab-Dummad-sabgumalale, degi, E-Igar-Maidba an nanamalale, an wismarsundo, anmar Bab-Dummad-mimmigan sabmalad.
Ar Bab-Dummad-sabgulegedi, E-Igar-Mamaidba-nanalegedgi sabguleged, ar E-Igar-Mamaid dutusursulid.
Ar bela dule-Bab-Dummadgi-gwalulesmaladi, we-napneggi-isgued-galagwensuli-nikad-birgi obined. Ar anmar Jesucristoʼgi bensulidbali, we-napneggi-isgued-naid-birgi obichamardo.
¿Ar doa we-napneggi-isgued-naid-birgi obinsunna? Dule-bensulidba-sogedi, Jesús, Bab-Dummad-Machiye, a-dule, we-napneggi-isgued-naid-birgi obined.
Jesucristo, Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadid

Jesucristo we-napnegse nonigu, diigi-oglesad, degi, burgwisadgi ablis-milesbalid. Unnila diiginbi-oglessulid, e-ablis-milesbalid. We-gusadi, Bab-Burba, anmarga soged, ar ade, Bab-Burbadi, napira-ibmar-soged.
Ar e-warbaa anmarga nibneggi sunmaked: Baba, Gayaburba-Nued, degi, Bab-Burba-Isligwaled. Ar wemar-warbaagwadi, wargwennaa gued.
Degine, napneggi we-warbaagumaladi, Jesucristoʼgi anmarga sunmaked: Bab-Burba, dii, abe. Ar wemar-warbaagwad bela na emarbi sunmaked.
Anmar dulemar-ibmar-soged itodamalad, Bab-Dummad-ibmar-soged-bursunna, bur itogergebed. Ar Bab-Dummad dulemarba bur dummadid. Deginbali, Bab-Dummad na E-Machigi anmarga sunmakbalid.

Ar dule Bab-Dummad-Machigi-bensulile, na e-gwagegine bato ega sognaido, we Bab-Dummad-soged, nabirye. Ar dule, Bab-Dummad-soged abingasulirdi, Bab-Dummadga sognaido, be gakansaed-duleye. Ar ade, Bab-Dummad-E-Machigi-ibmar-sogsad abingasulid.
Ar Bab-Dummad anmarga weyob sunmaknaid: Bab-Dummad anmarga san-burba-geg-bergued uksad. We burba-geg-bergued Bab-Dummad-Machigi danikid.
Ar dule Bab-Dummad-Machi-abingasadi, san-burba-geg-bergued bato nikad. Ar dule Bab-Dummad-Machi-abingasuliddi, san-burba-geg-bergued niksulid.
Bemar Bab-Dummad-Machigi-bensurmaladga, we-ibmarmar an narmaked, adi, bemar wisgumalagar, bemar burba-geg-bergued nikamarye. Degine, adi, Bab-Dummad-Machi-nuggi be bensuli gumalagar.
Ar anmar weyob Bab-Dummadgi-bensulid: Ar anmar e-sogedba ese ibmar egichidele, Bab-Dummad anmar-itoged.
Ar anmar wisile, Bab-Dummadse-anmar-ibmar-egisedi, Bab-Dummad anmar-itodaye. Degisoggu, anmar wismarsundo, anmar ibmar-ese-egichisad bato nikamalad.

Ar dule-wargwen e-gwenad isgudi-dakele, we-isgued dule-oburgwedsulile, Bab-Dummadse ega golo. Adi, Bab-Dummad we-dule-dulagudii saoed. We-an-bega-sogedi, isgued dule-oburgwegaga-imaksulidgi an soged. Ar isgued-burgwedse-dule-sededgardi, Bab-Dummadse-ega-be-gorye an sogsulid.
Ar igar-innikigwad-maidba ibmar-imaklesulile, we isgueddo. Isgued sogbo nikado: Dule-oburgwed, degi, dule-oburgwesulid.
Anmar wisid, dule Bab-Dummadgi gwalulesale, geg isguedgi yeer-itodii gued. Ar ade, Bab-Dummad-Machi we-dule-edarbedidaed. Degisoggu, nia-saila geg ebusunnad.
Anmar wismardo, anmardina Bab-Dummadgad gumalad, degine, bela dule-we-napneg-naidgi-bukmaladi nia-saila-sogedba gudidimalad.

Ar anmar wisbardo, Bab-Dummad-Machi we-napnegse nonikid. A Bab-Dummad-napiragwad-maid magar-ito anmar-imaknonikid. Degisoggu, anmar E-Machi-Jesucristoʼgi, dule-napiragwadba gudisunnad. Ar we-Jesucristo Bab-Dummad-napiragwadid, degi, san-burba-geg-bergued-sunnadbalid.
Mimmigan, ibmar-bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladgi nue salakarmalo, egi bangumalo. Be itomargua.
